description.value: River Wrangler Sportfishing is a fully licensed and insured Fraser Valley outfitter specializing in White Sturgeon and Salmon fishing on the Fraser and Harrison rivers. Guided trips depart from Chilliwack, about an hour east of Vancouver, aboard custom heated and covered jet boats. The operation also offers jet boat tours of the river systems, including sightings of Bald Eagles during the fall salmon spawn.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms this is an active sportfishing guiding business in Chilliwack, BC, operating on the Fraser River. The site provides phone and email contact info matching OSM's URL source, but no physical street address is listed. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site — the business operates via jet boats on the river, so a fixed land facility with amenities is not clearly evidenced.
